text: Install the official CLI and launch a GPU pod with a time-to-live that removes it automatically
quote: pip install lium.io && lium up --gpu H100 --ttl 1h# auto-removes after 1h

text: An agent can start a pod, run a job and remove the pod while staying within a budget you set
quote: Your agent starts a pod, runs the job and removes it, within a budget you set.

text: An agent can do everything without a browser: sign up, fund, rent, connect to and remove pods
quote: An agent can do everything on Lium with no browser: sign up, fund, rent, connect and remove pods.

text: Any docs page is available as raw markdown by adding .md to the URL or sending an Accept: text/markdown header
quote: Add `.md` to any page URL for raw markdown (e.g. `/providers/quickstart.md`), or send `Accept: text/markdown`.

text: One JSON call lists every rentable GPU node, with no API key or signup
quote: Every rentable GPU node on Lium in one JSON call. No key, no signup.

text: Public CSV price feed for spreadsheets and data warehouses
quote: Price feed, CSV | https://lium.io/pricing.csv | spreadsheets, data warehouses

text: Public WebSocket that streams which executors are rentable now, with no API key and no polling
quote: A public WebSocket that keeps you up to date on which executors are rentable now. Use it instead of polling `GET /executors`. No API key needed.

text: Rent-by-spec API rents the cheapest node that matches a GPU spec under a maximum price per GPU-hour
quote: rent-by-spec (`POST /executors/rent-by-spec`) that rents the cheapest node matching a GPU spec under a `max_price_per_gpu_hour` ceiling

text: API keys have scopes plus daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets that the server enforces
quote: API keys with scopes and per-key daily, monthly and lifetime USD budgets enforced by the server

text: Key scopes are fixed when a key is created and cannot be changed later
quote: Scopes limit what a key can do. They are set when you create the key and can't be changed later.

text: Root access and Docker-in-Docker on every pod
quote: root and Docker-in-Docker on every pod; pod volumes encrypted at rest by default on the default templates

text: Billing is per second, with no minimum and no reservation
quote: You pay **per second**: `hourly price × seconds / 3600`, with no minimum.

text: Payment by card, US bank debit (ACH), crypto, TAO or alpha
quote: Pay by card, US bank debit (ACH), crypto, TAO or alpha.

text: A pod is deleted automatically when it reaches a set number of hours, an end time, or a USD spend cap
quote: Pick one, and the pod is deleted when it is reached: Hours... End time... Spend cap: a budget in USD

text: A pod's local volume is backed up every 6 hours and kept 2 days, so it can be restored on another node
quote: the pod's local volume is backed up every 6 hours and kept 2 days, so you can restore it on another node

text: Optional Jupyter notebook on the pod
quote: Turn it on to get a Jupyter notebook on the pod.

text: Persistent Volumes outlive pods and are mounted at /mnt when attached
quote: A **Volume** is storage that outlives your pods. Attach one to a pod and it is mounted at **`/mnt`**.

text: Clusters of several whole machines on the same RDMA fabric for distributed jobs
quote: A cluster is several whole machines on the same RDMA fabric, for one distributed job.

text: API errors carry stable error codes plus hints on what to do next
quote: **`error.code`** is stable. Branch on it, not on the message. **`error.hint`** says what to do next.

text: lium exec runs remote commands and exits with the remote command's exit code
quote: lium exec job "nvidia-smi"                              # exits with the remote command's exit code

text: SDK rents the cheapest matching node, runs a function there, returns the result, then removes the pod or keeps it warm
quote: The SDK rents the cheapest matching node, runs the function there, returns the result and removes the pod (or keeps it warm).

text: Fingerprint signup creates an account with one API call, with no email, password or confirmation link
quote: fingerprint signup: one call to `POST /auth/signup`, no email, no password, no confirmation link.

text: CLI spend command shows burn per hour, spend per pod and remaining runway
quote: lium spend                                     # burn per hour, spend per pod, runway
